title: Retained-cutoff replay suppression outside the ledger
scope: Use the retained tenant/subject erasure cutoff to suppress pre-cutoff operator history replay and online learning fan-out before either path can recreate erased state or measurement effects.
non_goals: Partial W06/F06 replay repair only: no capability/socket generation, concurrent/deferred writer serialization, existing-ring reader filtering, seen-state migration, orphan discovery, D1, telemetry/log/external deletion, retention or accountability decision.
Preserve point-in-time semantics: records after the retained cutoff may be new evidence. Do not infer D03 transactional authority or D06 retention/re-entry policy and do not claim complete erasure.

Three production modules and three existing fixtures only. No new suite/harness, broad build or benchmark, deployment/cloud/credentials/customer data, commit/push, destructive cleanup or subdelegation.

criteria.description: A strict exact tenant/subject tombstone point read validates the same retained active record as ledger readers. History rows at or before any supplied-visitor or resolved-target cutoff are skipped before session/DO/history writes; post-cutoff and unrelated rows remain eligible on both hosts, and DO success is reported only from a successful ok:true acknowledgment.

Online decision fan-out removes records at or before the visitor cutoff before both ring append and personalized exposure posts, and pre-cutoff outcomes never reach ring attribution. Missing, unreadable or corrupt barrier state produces zero fan effects; post-cutoff, unrelated, holdout and consent-authorized behavior remains intact without adding response-path latency.

The three existing fixtures prove mixed inclusive cutoffs, both history hosts, truthful counts/no empty creation, strict failure containment, tenant/subject isolation, decision/exposure/outcome effects and unchanged consent/holdout positives. Worker exact K1 plus app noEmit/scoped diff; independent exact K1 once and frozen source/proof/import pins.

checks.workload: Three existing directly affected fixtures only; retained-cutoff history and learning effects plus existing consent/holdout regressions. Worker app noEmit and scoped diff; no latency or deployed claim.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.05 actual source and complete worker proof review; exact K1 once; relevant local import graph and physical pins; retain review-v1.md.
checks.runtime: Independent local frozen artifact review; actual history and learning fan-out with synthetic storage only.
checks.workload: C1-C3 cutoff validation, both-host history, fan effects/failure behavior, isolation and truthful limits; inspect compiler/scoped diff evidence without rerun. No broad/deployed qualification.

dependencies.consumed_output: Retained strict tenant/visitor point-in-time tombstones and inclusive pre-cutoff suppression semantics.
dependencies.rationale: This task reuses the established durable barrier for two non-ledger ingress paths without changing its lifecycle.
